title: Confidence on a relation: a graph built from repeated occurrence, not only affirmation

sections.name: words
sections.content:
Let's take a look at any existing issue or program research we have for weight on relations. I want to build up a set of use case examples.

Our affirmation process may also benefit from a confidence rating on a relationship. This will allow us to dynamically build a graph from repeated occurrence rather than owner affirmation
